description: Search the JENRIKS archive (one photo per day since 2006). Free-text query matches title, place, categories, tags and photographer; filters narrow by photographer, category, year and location. Returns permanent page URLs, credits, coordinates and image URLs, newest first. Page with offset, or with the opaque cursor from next_cursor (cursor wins when both are sent).

category.description: One of: Abstract, Architecture, B&W, Humans, Landscapes, Macro, Nature, News, Street, Studio, Time exposure

cursor.description: Opaque page token from next_cursor; overrides offset

name: search_photos

cursor.description: Echo of the cursor this page was fetched with, when one was sent

next.description: The same request with cursor=next_cursor and no offset; null on the last page

next_cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page; null on the last page. Send it back as cursor.

next_offset.description: Kept for offset paging; present when more matches exist

offset.description: Offset of the first returned row; 0 when a cursor was used

camera.description: Camera the photo was taken with, when the file carries it

credit.description: Ready-made credit line: photographer, JENRIKS, page URL

geo.description: WGS 84 coordinates of the location when the post carries them, otherwise null

lens.description: Lens the photo was taken with, when the file carries it

title: Search photos
